responsibility: Implements the AVX10.2-512 BF16 intrinsic layer for full-width 512-bit bfloat16 vectors. It conditionally enables `avx10.2-512` and provides the public `_mm512_*_pbh` API for packed BF16 arithmetic, classification, comparison, scaling, reduction, mantissa extraction, and masked/zero-masked variants by mapping those operations to the corresponding GCC BF16 builtins on `__m512bh` values.
